title: X Agent — Claude Code plugin (skill + local MCP server) that makes an agent a precise designer/builder of WordPress block layouts against a live instance running the X Companion plugin
mission: Give the agent a compiler, a verifier, and a discipline. The agent generates JSON block trees (never serialized markup), validated against the target instance's real registry, compiled to canonical markup by driving the instance's harness page in a warm headless browser, and verified numerically against a design spec instead of screenshot-squinting. When the instance's block vocabulary can't express a design region, the agent scaffolds a dynamic block, smoke-tests it in a local Playground, and installs it to the instance — which immediately makes it part of the vocabulary.

problem_context.why: Gutenberg persisted markup validity is defined by each block's JS save() output; hand-writing it fails in the editor. Current practice (generate HTML -> convert -> screenshot-diff loop) is not engineering. This plugin replaces it with: manifest -> tree -> validate -> compile (real save() in real browser) -> numeric layout verify -> one final visual acceptance.
problem_context.instance_as_ground_truth: All vocabulary (blocks, patterns, tokens) comes from the connected WP instance at its current fingerprint (epoch). Never from training-data memory of 'what WordPress has'.

two_input_modes.from_prompt: Creativity is expressed through the design-token system (theme.json vocabulary), not free CSS/HTML.
two_input_modes.from_design: Images/Figma are LIFTED into a Design Spec IR (measured geometry + inferred tokens + content inventory) by the agent's own vision, validated against a schema, then implemented and numerically diffed against that spec. Fidelity deltas are itemized decisions (snap-to-token log), never vibes.

counterpart.what: WordPress plugin on the target instance. Serves: GET /manifest, GET /fingerprint, POST /validate, POST /parse, POST /render, GET /patterns, GET /harness (the compile page), POST /blocks/install (+library mgmt), POST /theme/tokens, POST /snapshot/export. Namespace x-companion/v1, Basic auth with WP Application Passwords, contract interfaces.version '1'.
counterpart.postures: Instance may be 'toolchain' (sandbox, all routes) or 'production' (extend-tier routes 403 code=posture_forbidden). This plugin must read posture from GET /fingerprint and never attempt extend-tier calls against production — surface the constraint to the agent in tool descriptions and skill.
counterpart.division_of_labor: Instance serves capability; THIS side supplies all compute: warm Playwright (compiler + layout oracle), Node + @wordpress/scripts (block builds), @wp-playground/cli (smoke-test sandbox), the LLM (design lifting, tree generation). Credentials live only here (env/keychain), never in any relay — explicit rejection of the credential-custody model.
counterpart.shared_types: TreeIR, Diagnostics, Manifest exactly as defined in companion spec interfaces.shared_types. Vendor copies of those JSON Schemas into schemas/ and treat companion spec as canonical on conflict.

operating_rules_for_implementing_agent: Work until every milestone's acceptance commands pass. No questions after start. Unspecified details: choose simplest option consistent with 'all compute local, instance is ground truth', log in PROGRESS.json decisions[].

Before scaffolding, verify the CURRENT Claude Code plugin packaging format (plugin manifest filename/fields, how skills and MCP servers are declared) from https://docs.claude.com — do not trust memory. Record the verified format in PROGRESS.json decisions[]. Everything below is packaging-agnostic: it defines required components, not manifest syntax.
MCP server: TypeScript, @modelcontextprotocol/sdk, stdio transport, single package, no framework beyond it + playwright + zod (schema validation) + adm-zip.
Every MCP tool validates input AND output against its zod schema; tool errors are structured {code, message, hint}, never bare throws to the client.

The companion may be absent during development: ship tests/mock-companion/ (a tiny Node http server implementing the contract from vendored schemas + canned fixtures) so the full test suite runs with zero WordPress. Integration tests against a real instance are a separate opt-in script.

environment.runtime: Node >= 20, Playwright chromium, @wp-playground/cli available via npx.
environment.config: Connection config resolved from (in order): tool arguments > .x-agent.json in CWD > env vars X_WP_URL, X_WP_USER, X_WP_APP_PASSWORD. Never write the app password anywhere except the user's own .x-agent.json if the user placed it there.

file_layout.x-agent/<plugin-manifest per verified fo: Declares the skill and the MCP server command.
file_layout.x-agent/skills/wp-blocks/references/tree: TreeIR + Diagnostics quick reference with 3 worked examples (core page, kadence section, agent-block usage).
file_layout.x-agent/skills/wp-blocks/references/desi: Design Spec IR authoring guide for lifting (below).
file_layout.x-agent/mcp/src/session.ts: Warm browser pool: launches chromium once, loads /harness with Basic auth, awaits __ready, exposes compile(); auto-reloads page when fingerprint changes; falls back per companion README (real-editor injection) when __registry diff reports missing blocks — implement detection + reload-into-editor path behind a flag, default off, documented.
file_layout.x-agent/mcp/src/companion.ts: Typed client for all companion routes, epoch-aware (every call carries expected fingerprint; on E_EPOCH_MISMATCH/409 refresh manifest once and retry once, then surface).
file_layout.x-agent/templates/dynamic-block/: Scaffold (no-build): block.json (apiVersion 3, name agent/{slug}, render file, editorScript file:./edit.js), render.php (escaped attribute output, get_block_wrapper_attributes()), edit.js (vanilla JS against the wp.* globals — registerBlockType with save:()=>null, a ServerSideRender canvas, InspectorControls for declared attrs; no JSX, no module imports), edit.asset.php (static dependency manifest WordPress reads natively beside the script). No package.json, no src/, no node_modules: the bytes the gate tests are the bytes that ship.
file_layout.x-agent/templates/theme-json/emitter.ts: DesignTokens -> theme.json settings object (mirrors companion's server-side compiler for local preview/diff).
file_layout.x-agent/schemas/: Vendored: tree-ir.schema.json, diagnostics.schema.json, design-tokens.schema.json, design-spec.schema.json (defined below), manifest.schema.json.
file_layout.x-agent/fixtures/: Golden trees + expected markup + sample images (below).
file_layout.x-agent/tests/: vitest unit + mock-companion integration + optional live-instance script.
file_layout.PROGRESS.json: Ledger, same schema/rules as companion spec.

design_spec_ir.purpose: The pivot type that makes from-design use the same back half as from-prompt. Produced by the agent's vision (skill-guided), validated by tool wp_spec_validate, consumed by wp_verify as the numeric reference.

schema_outline.tokens_candidates: DesignTokens (same schema as companion /theme/tokens) + quantization_log: [{observed, snapped_to, delta}]
schema_outline.regions: recursive: [{id, role: 'header'|'hero'|'features'|'gallery'|'testimonial'|'cta'|'footer'|'section'|'column'|'item', box: {x,y,w,h} in source px, layout: {direction: 'row'|'column'|'grid', gap_px, align, justify, columns?}, style_refs: {palette_slug?, font_size_slug?, spacing_slugs?}, children: [region], responsive_assumptions: [{breakpoint, change, confidence: 'observed'|'synthesized'}]}]
schema_outline.notes: Every synthesized (not observed) responsive behavior MUST appear in responsive_assumptions with confidence='synthesized' — these are the human-vetoable items.

mcp_tools.name: wp_connect
mcp_tools.output: {site_url, posture, fingerprint, wp_version, blocks_count, suites: string[]}
mcp_tools.behavior: Fetch /fingerprint then /manifest, cache manifest in memory keyed by fingerprint, warm the harness session lazily (first compile). Refuse with {code:'https_required'} on plain http unless url is localhost/playground.

mcp_tools.name: wp_manifest
mcp_tools.output: Manifest (optionally filtered; blocks map can be large — support filter and a summary:true mode returning names+parents only)
mcp_tools.behavior: Serve cache unless refresh or fingerprint moved (cheap /fingerprint check, max once per 10s).

mcp_tools.name: wp_patterns
mcp_tools.behavior: Fetch /patterns once per fingerprint; local substring+category filter. This is the retrieval corpus — skill mandates checking it before novel composition.

mcp_tools.name: wp_validate
mcp_tools.behavior: POST /validate, plus LOCAL pre-check against vendored TreeIR schema so schema errors don't burn a round trip.

mcp_tools.name: wp_compile
mcp_tools.output: {markup, all_valid, invalid: [{path,name,validation_issues}], registry_gaps: string[] (manifest blocks missing from __registry), epoch}
mcp_tools.behavior: Ensure session warm at current fingerprint (reload page if epoch moved); call window.__compile; if registry_gaps intersects tree block names -> return {code:'harness_gap', blocks:[...]} error with hint to enable editor-injection fallback flag.

mcp_tools.name: wp_render
mcp_tools.behavior: POST /render (server-side dynamic-block rendering for preview and oracle of dynamic output).

mcp_tools.name: wp_verify
mcp_tools.input: {markup? | url?, spec?: DesignSpecIR, spec_region_id?: string, viewport: {width,height}}
mcp_tools.output: {box_tree: [{selector_path, block_name?, box:{x,y,w,h}, computed:{display,gap,fontSize,color,background}}], a11y_outline: [{role,name,level?}], diffs: [{region_id, kind: 'position'|'size'|'gap'|'font_size'|'color'|'missing'|'extra', expected, actual, delta, within_tolerance: bool}], pass: bool}
mcp_tools.behavior: If markup: create a throwaway draft? NO — no author routes in v1; instead render via /render into a local static page shell that enqueues the site's front-end stylesheet URLs returned by /render.enqueued_styles (best effort; if empty, load the site's homepage first to harvest theme stylesheet links, cache per fingerprint). If url: navigate directly. Extract per-element geometry via el.getBoundingClientRect + getComputedStyle for block wrapper elements (identify via .wp-block-* classes and data-block attributes where present). Diff numerically against spec regions when provided (match regions to elements by role heuristics + order + a11y name; unmatched -> 'missing'/'extra'). Tolerances: position/size 4px or 2%, gap 1 spacing-step, font 1px; make tolerances an optional input override. No spec -> return box_tree + a11y_outline only, pass=true.
mcp_tools.note: This is the oracle. Screenshot comparison is deliberately NOT a tool primitive; wp_screenshot exists for the single final human acceptance image only.

mcp_tools.name: wp_screenshot
mcp_tools.behavior: One full-page screenshot via the warm browser. Skill restricts usage to final acceptance.

mcp_tools.name: wp_spec_validate
mcp_tools.behavior: Local: schema check; children boxes within parent box (2% slack); every content.region_id resolves; tokens_candidates values all appear in quantization_log (W_UNQUANTIZED otherwise); at least one responsive_assumptions entry per top-level region (W_NO_RESPONSIVE).

mcp_tools.name: wp_tokens_apply
mcp_tools.behavior: POST /theme/tokens. Extend tier: check posture first, structured refusal {code:'posture_forbidden', hint:'clone to sandbox via wp_snapshot then apply there'} on production.

mcp_tools.name: wp_block_scaffold
mcp_tools.input: {slug, title, attributes: [{name, type, default?, control: 'text'|'textarea'|'number'|'toggle'|'select', options?}], render_intent: string (natural-language description embedded as a comment for the agent to implement render.php against)}
mcp_tools.behavior: Copy templates/dynamic-block, interpolate. Never scaffolds static blocks.

mcp_tools.name: wp_block_build_test
mcp_tools.output: {built: bool, smoke: {registered: bool, rendered_html: string, php_error?: string}, zip_path?}
mcp_tools.behavior: Syntax-gate every shipped script (node --check; module mode for a viewScriptModule) — there is no compile step, so the gate exercises the exact bytes that ship; boot @wp-playground/cli with a blueprint that installs the block dir as a plugin wrapper (generate a one-line loader plugin around register_block_type); assert block appears in /wp/v2/block-types and POST-render sample markup through Playground's REST; on success produce zip per companion install policy (block.json at root, render present, size<5MB). Any failure returns structured details — this local gate is THE safety mechanism; companion deliberately does not lint PHP.

mcp_tools.name: wp_block_install
mcp_tools.behavior: POST /blocks/install; on success immediately refresh manifest + reload harness session to the new epoch, and return the new fingerprint so the calling agent adopts it in subsequent trees. Posture-guarded like wp_tokens_apply.

mcp_tools.name: wp_parse
mcp_tools.behavior: POST /parse — brownfield lifting of existing content into trees (strip innerHTML/innerContent, keep name/attrs/innerBlocks to form TreeIR; provide both raw and stripped forms).

mcp_tools.name: wp_snapshot
mcp_tools.behavior: POST /snapshot/export streamed to disk. The clone-to-sandbox and promotion-gate primitive (fingerprint inside the zip vs target's /fingerprint).

skill_contract.frontmatter: name + description tuned to trigger on: WordPress blocks/Gutenberg, block themes, page/pattern/layout building, converting designs to WordPress, theme.json, and any mention of a site running X Companion.
mandatory_rules_the_skill_must_state: R1 NEVER hand-write serialized block markup ('<!-- wp:'). Generate TreeIR; markup exists only as wp_compile output.
R2 Vocabulary = wp_manifest at current fingerprint. Never assume a block exists; never use attributes not in the manifest entry (W_ATTR_UNKNOWN warnings are review items, not noise).
R3 Every tree carries epoch = current fingerprint. On any epoch_mismatch, refresh manifest, regenerate or re-validate, continue.

R4 Styling ONLY via theme tokens (preset slugs / supports attributes: backgroundColor, fontSize, spacing presets, layout). Raw CSS/HTML styling is forbidden; if tokens can't express it, that is a vocabulary gap -> R7 ladder, not an inline style.

R5 Loop: retrieve (wp_patterns first — adapt idioms before inventing) -> generate tree -> wp_validate (fix all errors, review warnings) -> wp_compile (must be all_valid) -> wp_verify against spec/expectations (fix diffs outside tolerance) -> repeat. wp_screenshot exactly once, at the end, as acceptance evidence.

R6 from-design mode: lift binaries into DesignSpecIR per references/design-spec.md (measure, don't trace; quantize every observed value onto the token scale and log the delta; mark every synthesized responsive behavior). wp_spec_validate must pass before any tree is generated. wp_verify diffs are then attributable: token decision, mapping approximation, or vocabulary gap.

R7 Vocabulary-gap ladder, in order: (1) different composition of existing blocks; (2) a block style/pattern; (3) new dynamic block via wp_block_scaffold -> implement render.php -> wp_block_build_test (must pass) -> wp_block_install -> adopt new fingerprint. Static blocks are never created.

R8 Posture awareness: extend-tier tools fail on production posture by design. For structural work on a production site: wp_snapshot -> work in a sandbox instance -> promote artifacts. Never look for a way around the gate.
R9 Greenfield ordering: design tokens FIRST (as DesignTokens JSON, kept as source of truth), wp_tokens_apply, then layout. theme.json is a compile target, not the design system itself.
R10 Credentials stay in local config; never echo the app password into conversation, files, or tool outputs.
worked_examples_required: from-design: single hero image -> spec -> tree -> verify with one deliberate token-snap delta
vocabulary gap: testimonial card -> R7 ladder end-to-end

fixtures.authoring_rule: Ground-truth markup fixtures are CAPTURED, not hand-written: drive a real Playground editor via Playwright once (script: tests/capture-golden.ts), build the fixture content interactively via wp.data dispatch, save, snapshot post_content. Hand-authored expected markup is the original sin of this domain and is forbidden even in tests.
set: trees/valid-with-agent-block.json (uses agent/testimonial from companion fixture package)
trees/invalid-*.json — one per Diagnostics error code
specs/hero-sample.json + images/hero-sample.png (render the golden landing hero at 1440px, screenshot it, lift-target)

progress_protocol.same_as: companion spec progress_protocol — identical file schema and rules, including decisions[] for the packaging-format verification and any tolerance tuning.

non_goals: No content publishing/author routes in v1 (use core WP REST directly if a task needs a draft; not wrapped as a tool yet).
No multi-agent orchestration machinery — this plugin is the toolchain one agent (or many, externally coordinated) uses.
No hosted anything: no relay, no telemetry, no credential leaves the machine.
No screenshot-diff loop primitives — numeric oracle is the loop; screenshot is terminal evidence only.
No static block generation under any circumstances.
No LSP in this package (future thin client over the same manifest/validate).
